info.description: Every word of /campus/ that is not a facility. The facilities themselves are the Campus Facility collection beside this; the band headings, the six featured rooms and the visit call-to-action are here. ⚠ FIELD NAMES MATCH THE BANDS ON THE PAGE, in page order: overview, categories, gallery, featured, journey, visit. ⚠ WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: the section-rail labels and anchors (they are tied to DOM ids — an edit would break the in-page links), the gallery's own heading (it counts the photographs and must stay derived), and interface labels such as All / Load more / Close (chrome, not content).
